name: LockedPreviewBody - Before The Password
description: The resting state of a password-protected preview, and the state most people who follow a protected link will ever see. The only interactive island this repo ships to the public site rather than to /admin. The lock string beside it carries version, iterations, salt and IV — none of them secret, which is the point of encrypting rather than prompting. The password is stored nowhere, so this page cannot be driven past the prompt; the unlocked half is proven at the application level, where a real password decrypts real ciphertext.
